en_us: At night, a villager at the foot of its bed lies down in it. Before, a villager with no free place near the head of its bed stayed awake all the night.
fr_fr: La nuit, un villageois au pied de son lit se couche dedans. Avant, un villageois sans place libre près de la tête de son lit restait éveillé toute la nuit.
